name: Cryengine
what_it_is: The Cryengine has long been known for its rich visual abilities, the flagship games from this engine often being used as benchmarks to determine a computer’s strength. Up till very recently, there were costs associated with this engine that kept it from the hands of many small developers. Now, it is a pay-what-you-want model which means you could download it for free just to try it out and see if you like it
